title: YEEZY BOOST 380
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Calcite Glow’ highlights a neutral combination of white and grey tones on the breathable Primeknit upper, complete with camo-like glow-in-the-dark detailing that’s revealed when the lights go out. A dark grey finish distinguishes the translucent monofilament window on the sneaker’s side panel, matching the sock-like collar that provides a snug fit around the ankle. A full-length Boost midsole delivers responsive cushioning with each step.

title: YEEZY SLIDES INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Slides Infants ‘Glow Green’ pairs an eye-catching one-note finish with a minimalist design built for comfort. A vivid shade of green is applied to the slip-on, crafted from injected EVA foam and equipped with a heel strap for an extra-secure fit. Debossed at the base of the plush footbed, adidas’ Three Stripes logo represents the only bit of exterior branding. The sandal rides on a sawtooth outsole that delivers both grippy traction and impact protection.
